{{Youmay|the title |the [[Bard|droid]] in the [[canon]] continuity}}
A '''bard''' was the term used to denote the best [[Singer (Kari)|singers]] in [[Kari]] society.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>

"Bard" was also the term used for itinerant [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] [[Poet/Legends|poets]] and storytellers.<ref name="H&R">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
